parameters.name: BizDate
parameters.description: The business date. This is typically 00:00:00 of the day before the scheduled time of the periodic instance. The value is a millisecond-level timestamp, such as 1743350400000.

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description:
The project environment. Valid values:
- Prod: production
- Dev: development

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter. The value is in JSON format. Multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship. Currently supported fields: `status, executionDate`.

parameters.name: Ids
parameters.description: The list of workflow instance IDs. You can use this parameter to query information about multiple workflow instances in a batch.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The account ID of the owner.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The list of sort fields. Sorting by scheduled time, start time, and other fields is supported. The format is "sort field + sort order (Desc/Asc)". Asc is the default if omitted. Valid values for the sort field:
- TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)
- StartedTime (Desc/Asc)
- FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
- Id (Desc/Asc)

Default value: Id Desc.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The list of tags. Results are returned if any one of the specified tags matches.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the workflow instance. Valid values:
- Normal: periodic scheduling
- Manual: manual task
- SmokeTest: test
- SupplementData: data backfill
- ManualWorkflow: manual workflow
- TriggerWorkflow: trigger-based workflow

parameters.name: UnifiedWorkflowInstanceId
parameters.description: The unified workflow instance ID. All workflow instances within the same business date under a specific trigger share the same value for this field.

parameters.name: WorkflowId
parameters.description: The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs.
